description: How much of the user's library is indexed, and whether the index is still growing. Returns the sources indexed, the batches still pending, and the index fingerprint. Poll this after indexing, never the index directly. Authentication and an active paid plan are required. The user's keyed profile (derived locally, sent per request) is also required.

profile.description: The user's keyed profile, sent per request. Only its fingerprint travels onward.

name: index_status
title: Check the user's Tier 1 index status
